name: clip1
text: Strong wind sweeping across a wide grass plain at dawn, rows of plain white and crimson cloth banners on poles snapping and flapping wildly, clouds racing fast across the sky, the camera tracking quickly sideways along the banners. Dramatic cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no writing on banners, no logos.

name: clip2
text: Dust and smoke billowing and drifting fast across an open battlefield plain at midday, dozens of plain unmarked banners whipping in the wind, flocks of birds scattering into the sky, the camera sweeping forward and rising. Dramatic cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip3
text: A tall traditional Japanese castle keep on massive stone walls under a stormy sky, dark clouds rolling quickly, gusts of wind bending nearby pine trees, the camera circling around the castle. Dramatic cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip4
text: A plain golden folding-fan shaped standard on a tall pole toppling and falling to the ground in strong wind, dust kicking up as it lands, loose cloth flapping, the camera low to the ground following the fall. Dramatic cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip5
text: An old quiet shrine ground with a huge ancient tree, autumn leaves swirling and spiralling through the air in the wind, stone lanterns, rays of light moving through branches, the camera slowly circling. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.
